name: scrawl
description: Scrape pages to Markdown or JSON, map sites, crawl into versioned datasets, extract with a schema, ask cited questions and download files with Scrawl, over its MCP server or the scrawl CLI.

api_key.title: Scrawl API key
api_key.description: The ApexAPI key ApexAi issues for your Scrawl account. Sent only as the Authorization: Bearer header to the MCP URL below, and kept in Claude Code's secure storage, not in settings.json.

mcp_url.title: Scrawl MCP URL
mcp_url.description: Scrawl's Streamable HTTP MCP endpoint for your account, ending in /mcp. Use https:// for any host that is not this machine. Default: a loopback address, because Scrawl's MCP server currently accepts only local connections.

base_url.title: Scrawl API base URL
base_url.description: Scrawl's ApexAPI base URL for your account, used by the scrawl CLI as SCRAWL_BASE_URL. Default: a loopback address.
